main.description: A skill a builder declares on themselves, owned by the builder's atproto repo. Build Guild's D1 is only an index of these records.

externalRef.description: Optional canonical reference for the skill concept, e.g. an ESCO URI (http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/<uuid>). Confirmed by the builder.

externalLabel.description: Human label of the external concept, for display.
